verses.ar: وَكَلَّمَ دَاوُدُ ٱلرَّبَّ بِكَلَامِ هَذَا ٱلنَّشِيدِ فِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلَّذِي أَنْقَذَهُ فِيهِ ٱلرَّبُّ مِنْ أَيْدِي كُلِّ أَعْدَائِهِ وَمِنْ يَدِ شَاوُلَ،
verses.kjv: And David spake unto the LORD the words of this song in the day [that] the LORD had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:
verses.web: David spoke to Yahweh the words of this song in the day that Yahweh delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul,
verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר דָּוִד֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֖י הַשִּׁירָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את בְּיֹום֩ הִצִּ֨יל יְהוָ֥ה אֹתֹ֛ו מִכַּ֥ף כָּל־אֹיְבָ֖יו וּמִכַּ֥ף שָׁאֽוּל׃

verses.ar: فَقَالَ: «اَلرَّبُّ صَخْرَتِي وَحِصْنِي وَمُنْقِذِي،
verses.kjv: And he said, The LORD [is] my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;
verses.web: and he said: “Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer, even mine;
verses.he: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר יְהוָ֛ה סַֽלְעִ֥י וּמְצֻדָתִ֖י וּמְפַלְטִי־לִֽי׃

verses.ar: إِلَهُ صَخْرَتِي بِهِ أَحْتَمِي. تُرْسِي وَقَرْنُ خَلَاصِي. مَلْجَإِي وَمَنَاصِي. مُخَلِّصِي، مِنَ ٱلظُّلْمِ تُخَلِّصُنِي.
verses.kjv: The God of my rock; in him will I trust: [he is] my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; thou savest me from violence.
verses.web: God is my rock in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge. My savior, you save me from violence.
verses.he: אֱלֹהֵ֥י צוּרִ֖י אֶחֱסֶה־בֹּ֑ו מָגִנִּ֞י וְקֶ֣רֶן יִשְׁעִ֗י מִשְׂגַּבִּי֙ וּמְנוּסִ֔י מֹשִׁעִ֕י מֵחָמָ֖ס תֹּשִׁעֵֽנִי׃

verses.ar: أَدْعُو ٱلرَّبَّ ٱلْحَمِيدَ فَأَتَخَلَّصُ مِنْ أَعْدَائِي.
verses.kjv: I will call on the LORD, [who is] worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
verses.web: I call on Yahweh, who is worthy to be praised; So shall I be saved from my enemies.
verses.he: מְהֻלָּ֖ל אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּמֵאֹיְבַ֖י אִוָּשֵֽׁעַ׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ أَمْوَاجَ ٱلْمَوْتِ ٱكْتَنَفَتْنِي. سُيُولُ ٱلْهَلَاكِ أَفْزَعَتْنِي.
verses.kjv: When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid;
verses.web: For the waves of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
verses.he: כִּ֥י אֲפָפֻ֖נִי מִשְׁבְּרֵי־מָ֑וֶת נַחֲלֵ֥י בְלִיַּ֖עַל יְבַעֲתֻֽנִי׃

verses.ar: حِبَالُ ٱلْهَاوِيَةِ أَحَاطَتْ بِي. شُرُكُ ٱلْمَوْتِ أَصَابَتْنِي.
verses.kjv: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me;
verses.web: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death caught me.
verses.he: חֶבְלֵ֥י שְׁאֹ֖ול סַבֻּ֑נִי קִדְּמֻ֖נִי מֹֽקְשֵׁי־מָֽוֶת׃

verses.ar: فِي ضِيقِي دَعَوْتُ ٱلرَّبَّ، وَإِلَى إِلَهِي صَرَخْتُ، فَسَمِعَ مِنْ هَيْكَلِهِ صَوْتِي، وَصُرَاخِي دَخَلَ أُذُنَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried to my God: and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry [did enter] into his ears.
verses.web: In my distress, I called on Yahweh. Yes, I called to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry came into his ears.
verses.he: בַּצַּר־לִי֙ אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֔ה וְאֶל־אֱלֹהַ֖י אֶקְרָ֑א וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע מֵהֵֽיכָלֹו֙ קֹולִ֔י וְשַׁוְעָתִ֖י בְּאָזְנָֽיו׃

verses.ar: فَٱرْتَجَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱرْتَعَشَتْ. أُسُسُ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ ٱرْتَعَدَتْ وَٱرْتَجَّتْ، لِأَنَّهُ غَضِبَ.
verses.kjv: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was wroth.
verses.web: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations of heaven quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
verses.he: *וַתְגָּעַשׁ (וַיִּתְגָּעַ֤שׁ) וַתִּרְעַשׁ֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ מֹוסְדֹ֥ות הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם יִרְגָּ֑זוּ וַיִּֽתְגָּעֲשׁ֖וּ כִּֽי־חָ֥רָה לֹֽו׃

verses.ar: صَعِدَ دُخَانٌ مِنْ أَنْفِهِ، وَنَارٌ مِنْ فَمِهِ أَكَلَتْ. جَمْرٌ ٱشْتَعَلَتْ مِنْهُ.
verses.kjv: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
verses.web: Smoke went up out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.
verses.he: עָלָ֤ה עָשָׁן֙ בְּאַפֹּ֔ו וְאֵ֥שׁ מִפִּ֖יו תֹּאכֵ֑ל גֶּחָלִ֖ים בָּעֲר֥וּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

verses.ar: طَأْطَأَ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَنَزَلَ، وَضَبَابٌ تَحْتَ رِجْلَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness [was] under his feet.
verses.web: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.
verses.he: וַיֵּ֥ט שָׁמַ֖יִם וַיֵּרַ֑ד וַעֲרָפֶ֖ל תַּ֥חַת רַגְלָֽיו׃

verses.ar: رَكِبَ عَلَى كَرُوبٍ، وَطَارَ وَرُئِيَ عَلَى أَجْنِحَةِ ٱلرِّيحِ.
verses.kjv: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind.
verses.web: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he was seen on the wings of the wind.
verses.he: וַיִּרְכַּ֥ב עַל־כְּר֖וּב וַיָּעֹ֑ף וַיֵּרָ֖א עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רֽוּחַ׃

verses.ar: جَعَلَ ٱلظُّلْمَةَ حَوْلَهُ مِظَلَّاتٍ، مِيَاهًا حَاشِكَةً وَظَلَامَ ٱلْغَمَامِ.
verses.kjv: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters, [and] thick clouds of the skies.
verses.web: He made darkness a shelter around himself, gathering of waters, and thick clouds of the skies.
verses.he: וַיָּ֥שֶׁת חֹ֛שֶׁךְ סְבִיבֹתָ֖יו סֻכֹּ֑ות חַֽשְׁרַת־מַ֖יִם עָבֵ֥י שְׁחָקִֽים׃

verses.ar: مِنَ ٱلشُّعَاعِ قُدَّامَهُ ٱشْتَعَلَتْ جَمْرُ نَارٍ.
verses.kjv: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled.
verses.web: At the brightness before him, coals of fire were kindled.
verses.he: מִנֹּ֖גַהּ נֶגְדֹּ֑ו בָּעֲר֖וּ גַּחֲלֵי־אֵֽשׁ׃

verses.ar: أَرْعَدَ ٱلرَّبُّ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ، وَٱلْعَلِيُّ أَعْطَى صَوْتَهُ.
verses.kjv: The LORD thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered his voice.
verses.web: Yahweh thundered from heaven. The Most High uttered his voice.
verses.he: יַרְעֵ֥ם מִן־שָׁמַ֖יִם יְהוָ֑ה וְעֶלְיֹ֖ון יִתֵּ֥ן קֹולֹֽו׃

verses.ar: أَرْسَلَ سِهَامًا فَشَتَّتَهُمْ، بَرْقًا فَأَزْعَجَهُمْ.
verses.kjv: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.
verses.web: He sent out arrows and scattered them, lightning and confused them.
verses.he: וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח חִצִּ֖ים וַיְפִיצֵ֑ם בָּרָ֖ק *וַיְּהֻמֵּם (וַיָּהֹֽם)׃

verses.ar: فَظَهَرَتْ أَعْمَاقُ ٱلْبَحْرِ، وَٱنْكَشَفَتْ أُسُسُ ٱلْمَسْكُونَةِ مِنْ زَجْرِ ٱلرَّبِّ، مِنْ نَسْمَةِ رِيحِ أَنْفِهِ.
verses.kjv: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
verses.web: Then the channels of the sea appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare by Yahweh’s rebuke, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
verses.he: וַיֵּֽרָאוּ֙ אֲפִ֣קֵי יָ֔ם יִגָּל֖וּ מֹסְדֹ֣ות תֵּבֵ֑ל בְּגַעֲרַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה מִנִּשְׁמַ֖ת ר֥וּחַ אַפֹּֽו׃

verses.ar: أَرْسَلَ مِنَ ٱلْعُلَى فَأَخَذَنِي، نَشَلَنِي مِنْ مِيَاهٍ كَثِيرَةٍ.
verses.kjv: He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters;
verses.web: He sent from on high and he took me. He drew me out of many waters.
verses.he: יִשְׁלַ֥ח מִמָּרֹ֖ום יִקָּחֵ֑נִי יַֽמְשֵׁ֖נִי מִמַּ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃

verses.ar: أَنْقَذَنِي مِنْ عَدُوِّيَ ٱلْقَوِيِّ، مِنْ مُبْغِضِيَّ لِأَنَّهُمْ أَقْوَى مِنِّي.
verses.kjv: He delivered me from my strong enemy, [and] from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.
verses.web: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me, for they were too mighty for me.
verses.he: יַצִּילֵ֕נִי מֵאֹיְבִ֖י עָ֑ז מִשֹּׂ֣נְאַ֔י כִּ֥י אָמְצ֖וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

verses.ar: أَصَابُونِي فِي يَوْمِ بَلِيَّتِي، وَكَانَ ٱلرَّبُّ سَنَدِي.
verses.kjv: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.
verses.web: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but Yahweh was my support.
verses.he: יְקַדְּמֻ֖נִי בְּיֹ֣ום אֵידִ֑י וַיְהִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה מִשְׁעָ֖ן לִֽי׃

verses.ar: أَخْرَجَنِي إِلَى ٱلرَّحْبِ. خَلَّصَنِي لِأَنَّهُ سُرَّ بِي.
verses.kjv: He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verses.web: He also brought me out into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verses.he: וַיֹּצֵ֥א לַמֶּרְחָ֖ב אֹתִ֑י יְחַלְּצֵ֖נִי כִּי־חָ֥פֵֽץ בִּֽי׃

verses.ar: يُكَافِئُنِي ٱلرَّبُّ حَسَبَ بِرِّي. حَسَبَ طَهَارَةِ يَدَيَّ يَرُدُّ عَلَيَّ.
verses.kjv: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
verses.web: Yahweh rewarded me according to my righteousness. He rewarded me according to the cleanness of my hands.
verses.he: יִגְמְלֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֖ה כְּצִדְקָתִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָדַ֖י יָשִׁ֥יב לִֽי׃

verses.ar: لِأَنِّي حَفِظْتُ طُرُقَ ٱلرَّبِّ، وَلَمْ أَعْصِ إِلَهِي.
verses.kjv: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.web: For I have kept Yahweh’s ways, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.he: כִּ֥י שָׁמַ֖רְתִּי דַּרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א רָשַׁ֖עְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָֽי׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ جَمِيعَ أَحْكَامِهِ أَمَامِي، وَفَرَائِضُهُ لَا أَحِيدُ عَنْهَا.
verses.kjv: For all his judgments [were] before me: and [as for] his statutes, I did not depart from them.
verses.web: For all his ordinances were before me. As for his statutes, I didn’t depart from them.
verses.he: כִּ֥י כָל־*מִשְׁפֹּטֹו (מִשְׁפָּטָ֖יו) לְנֶגְדִּ֑י וְחֻקֹּתָ֖יו לֹא־אָס֥וּר מִמֶּֽנָּה׃

verses.ar: وَأَكُونُ كَامِلًا لَدَيْهِ، وَأَتَحَفَّظُ مِنْ إِثْمِي.
verses.kjv: I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from mine iniquity.
verses.web: I was also perfect toward him. I kept myself from my iniquity.
verses.he: וָאֶהְיֶ֥ה תָמִ֖ים לֹ֑ו וָאֶשְׁתַּמְּרָ֖ה מֵעֲוֹנִֽי׃

verses.ar: فَيَرُدُّ ٱلرَّبُّ عَلَيَّ كَبِرِّي، وَكَطَهَارَتِي أَمَامَ عَيْنَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: Therefore the LORD hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight.
verses.web: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in his eyesight.
verses.he: וַיָּ֧שֶׁב יְהוָ֛ה לִ֖י כְּצִדְקָתִ֑י כְּבֹרִ֖י לְנֶ֥גֶד עֵינָֽיו׃

verses.ar: «مَعَ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَكُونُ رَحِيمًا. مَعَ ٱلرَّجُلِ ٱلْكَامِلِ تَكُونُ كَامِلًا.
verses.kjv: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful, [and] with the upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright.
verses.web: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man you will show yourself perfect.
verses.he: עִם־חָסִ֖יד תִּתְחַסָּ֑ד עִם־גִּבֹּ֥ור תָּמִ֖ים תִּתַּמָּֽם׃

verses.ar: مَعَ ٱلطَّاهِرِ تَكُونُ طَاهِرًا، وَمَعَ ٱلْأَعْوَجِ تَكُونُ مُلْتَوِيًا.
verses.kjv: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury.
verses.web: With the pure you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
verses.he: עִם־נָבָ֖ר תִּתָּבָ֑ר וְעִם־עִקֵּ֖שׁ תִּתַּפָּֽל׃

verses.ar: وَتُخَلِّصُ ٱلشَّعْبَ ٱلْبَائِسَ، وَعَيْنَاكَ عَلَى ٱلْمُتَرَفِّعِينَ فَتَضَعُهُمْ.
verses.kjv: And the afflicted people thou wilt save: but thine eyes [are] upon the haughty, [that] thou mayest bring [them] down.
verses.web: You will save the afflicted people, but your eyes are on the arrogant, that you may bring them down.
verses.he: וְאֶת־עַ֥ם עָנִ֖י תֹּושִׁ֑יעַ וְעֵינֶ֖יךָ עַל־רָמִ֥ים תַּשְׁפִּֽיל׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ سِرَاجِي يَارَبُّ، وَٱلرَّبُّ يُضِيءُ ظُلْمَتِي.
verses.kjv: For thou [art] my lamp, O LORD: and the LORD will lighten my darkness.
verses.web: For you are my lamp, Yahweh. Yahweh will light up my darkness.
verses.he: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֥ה נֵירִ֖י יְהוָ֑ה וַיהוָ֖ה יַגִּ֥יהַּ חָשְׁכִּֽי׃

verses.ar: لِأَنِّي بِكَ ٱقْتَحَمْتُ جَيْشًا. بِإِلَهِي تَسَوَّرْتُ أَسْوَارًا.
verses.kjv: For by thee I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall.
verses.web: For by you, I run against a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.
verses.he: כִּ֥י בְכָ֖ה אָר֣וּץ גְּד֑וּד בֵּאלֹהַ֖י אֲדַלֶּג־שֽׁוּר׃

verses.ar: ٱللهُ طَرِيقُهُ كَامِلٌ، وَقَوْلُ ٱلرَّبِّ نَقِيٌّ. تُرْسٌ هُوَ لِجَمِيعِ ٱلْمُحْتَمِينَ بِهِ.
verses.kjv: [As for] God, his way [is] perfect; the word of the LORD [is] tried: he [is] a buckler to all them that trust in him.
verses.web: As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tested. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
verses.he: הָאֵ֖ל תָּמִ֣ים דַּרְכֹּ֑ו אִמְרַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ צְרוּפָ֔ה מָגֵ֣ן ה֔וּא לְכֹ֖ל הַחֹסִ֥ים בֹּֽו׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ إِلَهٌ غَيْرُ ٱلرَّبِّ؟ وَمَنْ هُوَ صَخْرَةٌ غَيْرُ إِلَهِنَا؟
verses.kjv: For who [is] God, save the LORD? and who [is] a rock, save our God?
verses.web: For who is God, besides Yahweh? Who is a rock, besides our God?
verses.he: כִּ֥י מִי־אֵ֖ל מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וּמִ֥י צ֖וּר מִֽבַּלְעֲדֵ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

verses.ar: ٱلْإِلَهُ ٱلَّذِي يُعَزِّزُنِي بِٱلْقُوَّةِ، وَيُصَيِّرُ طَرِيقِي كَامِلًا.
verses.kjv: God [is] my strength [and] power: and he maketh my way perfect.
verses.web: God is my strong fortress. He makes my way perfect.
verses.he: הָאֵ֥ל מָעוּזִּ֖י חָ֑יִל וַיַּתֵּ֥ר תָּמִ֖ים *דַּרְכֹּו (דַּרְכִּֽי)׃

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِي يَجْعَلُ رِجْلَيَّ كَٱلْإِيَّلِ، وَعَلَى مُرْتَفَعَاتِي يُقِيمُنِي
verses.kjv: He maketh my feet like hinds’ [feet:] and setteth me upon my high places.
verses.web: He makes his feet like hinds’ feet, and sets me on my high places.
verses.he: מְשַׁוֶּ֥ה *רַגְלָיו (רַגְלַ֖י) כָּאַיָּלֹ֑ות וְעַ֥ל בָּמֹותַ֖י יַעֲמִדֵֽנִי׃

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِي يُعَلِّمُ يَدَيَّ ٱلْقِتَالَ، فَتُحْنَى بِذِرَاعَيَّ قَوْسٌ مِنْ نُحَاسٍ.
verses.kjv: He teacheth my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
verses.web: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.
verses.he: מְלַמֵּ֥ד יָדַ֖י לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְנִחַ֥ת קֶֽשֶׁת־נְחוּשָׁ֖ה זְרֹעֹתָֽי׃

verses.ar: وَتَجْعَلُ لِي تُرْسَ خَلَاصِكَ، وَلُطْفُكَ يُعَظِّمُنِي.
verses.kjv: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great.
verses.web: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your gentleness has made me great.
verses.he: וַתִּתֶּן־לִ֖י מָגֵ֣ן יִשְׁעֶ֑ךָ וַעֲנֹתְךָ֖ תַּרְבֵּֽנִי׃

verses.ar: تُوَسِّعُ خَطْوَاتِي تَحْتِي، فَلَمْ تَتَقَلْقَلْ كَعْبَايَ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip.
verses.web: You have enlarged my steps under me. My feet have not slipped.
verses.he: תַּרְחִ֥יב צַעֲדִ֖י תַּחְתֵּ֑נִי וְלֹ֥א מָעֲד֖וּ קַרְסֻלָּֽי׃

verses.ar: أَلْحَقُ أَعْدَائِي فَأُهْلِكُهُمْ، وَلَا أَرْجِعُ حَتَّى أُفْنِيَهُمْ.
verses.kjv: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them.
verses.web: I have pursued my enemies and destroyed them. I didn’t turn again until they were consumed.
verses.he: אֶרְדְּפָ֥ה אֹיְבַ֖י וָאַשְׁמִידֵ֑ם וְלֹ֥א אָשׁ֖וּב עַד־כַּלֹּותָֽם׃

verses.ar: أُفْنِيهِمْ وَأَسْحَقُهُمْ فَلَا يَقُومُونَ، بَلْ يَسْقُطُونَ تَحْتَ رِجْلَيَّ.
verses.kjv: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.
verses.web: I have consumed them, and struck them through, so that they can’t arise. Yes, they have fallen under my feet.
verses.he: וָאֲכַלֵּ֥ם וָאֶמְחָצֵ֖ם וְלֹ֣א יְקוּמ֑וּן וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ תַּ֥חַת רַגְלָֽי׃

verses.ar: «تُنَطِّقُنِي قُوَّةً لِلْقِتَالِ، وَتَصْرَعُ ٱلْقَائِمِينَ عَلَيَّ تَحْتِي.
verses.kjv: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me.
verses.web: For you have armed me with strength for the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.
verses.he: וַתַּזְרֵ֥נִי חַ֖יִל לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה תַּכְרִ֥יעַ קָמַ֖י תַּחְתֵּֽנִי׃

verses.ar: وَتُعْطِينِي أَقْفِيَةَ أَعْدَائِي وَمُبْغِضِيَّ فَأُفْنِيهِمْ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me.
verses.web: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.
verses.he: וְאֹ֣יְבַ֔י תַּ֥תָּה לִּ֖י עֹ֑רֶף מְשַׂנְאַ֖י וָאַצְמִיתֵֽם׃

verses.ar: يَتَطَلَّعُونَ فَلَيْسَ مُخَلِّصٌ، إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ فَلَا يَسْتَجِيبُهُمْ.
verses.kjv: They looked, but [there was] none to save; [even] unto the LORD, but he answered them not.
verses.web: They looked, but there was no one to save; even to Yahweh, but he didn’t answer them.
verses.he: יִשְׁע֖וּ וְאֵ֣ין מֹשִׁ֑יעַ אֶל־יְהוָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א עָנָֽם׃

verses.ar: فَأَسْحَقُهُمْ كَغُبَارِ ٱلْأَرْضِ. مِثْلَ طِينِ ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ أَدُقُّهُمْ وَأَدُوسُهُمْ.
verses.kjv: Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the street, [and] did spread them abroad.
verses.web: Then I beat them as small as the dust of the earth. I crushed them as the mire of the streets, and spread them abroad.
verses.he: וְאֶשְׁחָקֵ֖ם כַּעֲפַר־אָ֑רֶץ כְּטִיט־חוּצֹ֥ות אֲדִקֵּ֖ם אֶרְקָעֵֽם׃

verses.ar: وَتُنْقِذُنِي مِنْ مُخَاصَمَاتِ شَعْبِي، وَتَحْفَظُنِي رَأْسًا لِلْأُمَمِ. شَعْبٌ لَمْ أَعْرِفْهُ يَتَعَبَّدُ لِي.
verses.kjv: Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people, thou hast kept me [to be] head of the heathen: a people [which] I knew not shall serve me.
verses.web: You also have delivered me from the strivings of my people. You have kept me to be the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known will serve me.
verses.he: וַֽתְּפַלְּטֵ֔נִי מֵרִיבֵ֖י עַמִּ֑י תִּשְׁמְרֵ֙נִי֙ לְרֹ֣אשׁ גֹּויִ֔ם עַ֥ם לֹא־יָדַ֖עְתִּי יַעַבְדֻֽנִי׃

verses.ar: بَنُو ٱلْغُرَبَاءِ يَتَذَلَّلُونَ لِي. مِنْ سَمَاعِ ٱلْأُذُنِ يَسْمَعُونَ لِي.
verses.kjv: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me.
verses.web: The foreigners will submit themselves to me. As soon as they hear of me, they will obey me.
verses.he: בְּנֵ֥י נֵכָ֖ר יִתְכַּֽחֲשׁוּ־לִ֑י לִשְׁמֹ֥ועַ אֹ֖זֶן יִשָּׁ֥מְעוּ לִֽי׃

verses.ar: بَنُو ٱلْغُرَبَاءِ يَبْلَوْنَ وَيَزْحَفُونَ مِنْ حُصُونِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places.
verses.web: The foreigners will fade away, and will come trembling out of their close places.
verses.he: בְּנֵ֥י נֵכָ֖ר יִבֹּ֑לוּ וְיַחְגְּר֖וּ מִמִּסְגְּרֹותָֽם׃

verses.ar: حَيٌّ هُوَ ٱلرَّبُّ، وَمُبَارَكٌ صَخْرَتِي، وَمُرْتَفَعٌ إِلَهُ صَخْرَةِ خَلَاصِي.
verses.kjv: The LORD liveth; and blessed [be] my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.
verses.web: Yahweh lives! Blessed be my rock! Exalted be God, the rock of my salvation,
verses.he: חַי־יְהוָ֖ה וּבָר֣וּךְ צוּרִ֑י וְיָרֻ֕ם אֱלֹהֵ֖י צ֥וּר יִשְׁעִֽי׃

verses.ar: ٱلْإِلَهُ ٱلْمُنْتَقِمُ لِي، وَٱلْمُخْضِعُ شُعُوبًا تَحْتِي،
verses.kjv: It [is] God that avengeth me, and that bringeth down the people under me,
verses.web: even the God who executes vengeance for me, who brings down peoples under me,
verses.he: הָאֵ֕ל הַנֹּתֵ֥ן נְקָמֹ֖ת לִ֑י וּמֹורִ֥יד עַמִּ֖ים תַּחְתֵּֽנִי׃

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِي يُخْرِجُنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ أَعْدَائِي، وَيَرْفَعُنِي فَوْقَ ٱلْقَائِمِينَ عَلَيَّ، وَيُنْقِذُنِي مِنْ رَجُلِ ٱلظُّلْمِ.
verses.kjv: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.
verses.web: who brings me away from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.
verses.he: וּמֹוצִיאִ֖י מֵאֹֽיְבָ֑י וּמִקָּמַי֙ תְּרֹ֣ומְמֵ֔נִי מֵאִ֥ישׁ חֲמָסִ֖ים תַּצִּילֵֽנִי׃

verses.ar: لِذَلِكَ أَحْمَدُكَ يَارَبُّ فِي ٱلْأُمَمِ، وَلِٱسْمِكَ أُرَنِّمُ.
verses.kjv: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto thy name.
verses.web: Therefore I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.
verses.he: עַל־כֵּ֛ן אֹודְךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה בַּגֹּויִ֑ם וּלְשִׁמְךָ֖ אֲזַמֵּֽר׃

verses.ar: بُرْجُ خَلَاصٍ لِمَلِكِهِ، وَٱلصَّانِعُ رَحْمَةً لِمَسِيحِهِ، لِدَاوُدَ وَنَسْلِهِ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ».
verses.kjv: [He is] the tower of salvation for his king: and sheweth mercy to his anointed, unto David, and to his seed for evermore.
verses.web: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.”
verses.he: *מִגְדִיל (מִגְדֹּ֖ול) יְשׁוּעֹ֣ות מַלְכֹּ֑ו וְעֹֽשֶׂה־חֶ֧סֶד לִמְשִׁיחֹ֛ו לְדָוִ֥ד וּלְזַרְעֹ֖ו עַד־עֹולָֽם׃ פ
